scope: Paths J01 source-level test adequacy and CI selection pilot; no real provider, host, deployment or workflow dispatch
authorization: Operator instructed proceeding with the one-journey audit recommendation; local disposable source fixtures only
pre_run_review: Read all executed source and imports; exact Git blobs verified. Tests use local subprocesses, temporary Git fixtures and in-memory route callbacks. No network client is imported by these selected suites.
environment: CaaS Python 3.12.14 and Git, scrubbed child environment, temporary work and fixture directories; not an admitted installed backbone runner
substitutions: parity suite uses actual pinned gate scripts but substitutes composition model and recipes
owner checker is a local fixture
no real target readback or durable consumer ledger

obligations.requirement: Current owner admission precedes every selected callback, including fallback
obligations.observable: Revocation or failed owner validation produces zero subsequent callbacks

obligations.requirement: Actor, effect and target all match the admitted operation
obligations.observable: Wrong actor/effect/target never invokes a callback

obligations.requirement: Unavailable, unadmitted or quota-exhausted routes are not selected
obligations.basis: Current route preference and eligible-equivalent requirement
obligations.observable: An unavailable-only route produces zero callbacks; an eligible route still works

obligations.requirement: The selected Paths subject is current, tracked and clean before use
obligations.observable: Changed revision or tracked gate rejects before callback

obligations.requirement: A lookup failure gets machine diagnosis and only eligible equivalent continuation
obligations.observable: Lookup failure invokes actual selected gate entrypoints and eligible fallback, without invented human retry

obligations.requirement: Permission denial cannot trigger an alternate bypass
obligations.observable: Only the denying route is called

obligations.requirement: Unknown completion preserves original identity and prevents a second effect
obligations.observable: Pending callback stops the call sequence; restart and ledger recovery require separate installed proof

obligations.requirement: Provider response is preserved and final target correctness is established separately
obligations.basis: User requested actual target result; PATH_CONTRACT separates effect proof; J01
obligations.observable: Distinctive nested callback payload survives exactly; wrapper result remains nonfinal; installed consumer independently checks real target

obligations.requirement: Every selected test has explicit real-versus-substituted boundary scope
obligations.basis: Current owner56 checkpoint and testing foundation
obligations.observable: Local fixture passes are never recorded as live E2E or release acceptance

obligations.requirement: Changes capable of breaking the selected guard activate its unit and gate integration checks
obligations.basis: Derived from PO01-PO08 and actual dependency files, independently of current path filters
obligations.observable: Representative dependency changes choose executable suite commands; removing either suites or trigger coverage is detected

completion: Record baseline runs, independent outcome probes, bounded behavioral mutations and selector mutations; retain surviving faults and limits; update the preparation sequence without claiming runtime acceptance
